# Species and thermodynamic data {#sec-ch02}

This chapter describes the data kintera holds for each species before any thermodynamic function is evaluated: the
species list read from the YAML file, each species' phase and elemental composition, its molar mass, its constant
heat capacity and reference energy and entropy, its optional NASA-9 polynomial, and the saturation vapor pressure
fits attached to condensation reactions. The functions that turn these data into energies, entropies and the
equation of state are the subject of @sec-ch03.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch02-species-registry | `species`[^rg-e2c86a33eac7] | none | exact | `test_species_registry.py` |
| @sec-ch02-molar-mass | `composition`[^rg-e540c1be9eba] | none | exact | `test_equilibrium` |
| @sec-ch02-nasa9 | `use-nasa9-cp` | off | exact | `test_nasa9_cp.py` |
| @sec-ch02-svp | `rate-constant: formula` | none | exact | `test_vapor_functions` |
| @sec-ch02-svp-autograd | `LogSVPFunc` (API) | always | exact | `test_svp_autograd.py` |
| @sec-ch02-units | `UnitSystem` (API) | SI | exact | none |

: Schemes of the species chapter. "Order" is the order of the scheme's discretization; a function evaluated
pointwise is exact. {#tbl-ch02-schemes}
